page.overview:
What is Capcom vs. SNK?

Capcom vs. SNK belongs to Capcom vs. SNK. A revised version, Capcom vs.

SNK Pro, was released the following year, followed shortly thereafter by a sequel, Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001. The arcade version of Capcom vs.

SNK Pro was re-released in 2025 as part of Capcom Fighting Collection 2. SNK uses a "ratio" system, where the "ratio" is a rating of a character's overall strength, ranging from 1 to 4. Teams of up to four can be assembled, but their combined ratios must equal and go no higher than 4.

The gameplay uses the SNK-style four-button format. The player can also choose their "groove", or attack meter.
